name: Super Dope Prepackaged Flower | Mega Z Emerald Minis
description: Regenerate your Z palette with this gem. Mega Z Emerald takes the Zkittles terps that fans have come to know and love from our Mega Z Blue but with a blast of sour notes. Now the question is, Are you game?
